decisions.quote: We identified 19 loci to be associated with gallstone disease in the GBE. Of these, 12 were replicated in the Copenhagen cohorts, including six previously unknown loci (in hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha [ HNF4A ], fucosyltransferase 2, serpin family A member 1 [ SERPINA1 ], jumonji domain containing 1C, AC074212.3 , and solute carrier family 10A member 2 [ SLC10A2 ]) and six known loci (in adenosine triphosphate binding cassette subfamily G member 8 [ ABCG8 ], sulfotransferase family 2A member 1, cytochrome P450 7A1, transmembrane 4 L six family member 4, ABCB4 , and tetratricopeptide repeat domain 39B).
decisions.reason: The supplied text is only an abstract describing discovery in the UK Biobank (GBE) followed by validation in two Copenhagen cohorts, where 12 replicated loci included six novel loci and six known loci (including ABCG8). Without the full text, we cannot determine whether the study explicitly re-tests a specific prior published finding as a replication target or only reports internal validation of its genome-wide scan.
